<!-- generated by spindle-docs, do not edit -->

Checked against `main` and the planning store on 2026-11-04: 13 shipped, 10 planned. Every **shipped** item is held by a test on `main`, listed under the table. **Planned** is a story that is not implemented yet, or a milestone of the design with no story; nothing planned runs today.

| Area | Capability | Status | What it means |
|---|---|---|---|
| Specification | [Load and compile](/docs/concepts/specification) | shipped | A directory of ESS documents is compiled by ess-compiler to the resolved IR; a document ESS refuses is refused with ESS's diagnostics. |
| Capabilities | [Derived from the specification](/docs/concepts/capabilities) | shipped | Entities need store.durable, periodic bindings timer and clock, cross-component bindings channel, external outcomes external.&lt;command>.&lt;outcome>. |
| Capabilities | [Per component](/docs/concepts/capabilities) | shipped | capabilities --component lists only what one component needs when it runs on its own. |
| Admission | [Bind by preference](/docs/concepts/environment-and-admission) | shipped | Each required capability is bound to the first implementation the environment lists for it; an exact key wins over a prefix key. |
| Admission | [Refusal names what is missing](/docs/concepts/environment-and-admission) | shipped | A refused admission names every capability without an implementation and exits 3. |
| Execution | [Commands against the compiled model](/docs/reference/cli) | shipped | spindle-kernel selects the outcome by the IR's conditions and guards, applies its effect and emits its events; b10x-spindle run reads commands as JSON lines. |
| Execution | [Memory and SQLite stores](/docs/concepts/environment-and-admission) | shipped | The store follows the store.durable binding; SQLite state survives a restart. |
| Bindings | [Periodic bindings](/docs/concepts/components-and-bindings) | shipped | spindle-timer yields due ticks for periodic bindings on an injected clock, honouring the ESS periodic profile. |
| Bindings | [Event bindings in process and over TCP](/docs/concepts/components-and-bindings) | shipped | spindle-channel carries an event to the command it binds to, in process or as length-prefixed JSON frames over TCP; at_least_once redelivers. |
| Rally | [Every component in one process](/docs/examples/rally) | shipped | b10x-spindle play runs the three rally components in one process with in-process channels until a side wins. |
| Targets | [The target contract and the process launcher](/docs/concepts/deployment-targets) | shipped | Placement refuses an instance above its target's ceiling; the process launcher starts and stops an instance and reports its exit. |
| Targets | [QEMU microvm launcher](/docs/concepts/deployment-targets) | shipped | A library launcher: one qemu-system-x86_64 -M microvm per instance with KVM, without root. Its tests run on a host with /dev/kvm (task check:vm), not in CI. |
| Targets | [Firecracker launcher](/docs/concepts/deployment-targets) | shipped | A library launcher: Firecracker VMs on a bridge inside a user and network namespace, without root. Its tests need /dev/kvm, the Firecracker binary and a guest kernel (task check:vm), not in CI. |
| Rally | [Three processes](/docs/examples/rally) | planned | Three b10x-spindle run processes, one per component, joined by TCP channels. |
| Rally | [Three microVMs](/docs/examples/rally) | planned | Each rally component in its own microVM, joined by TCP channels across the VM network. |
| Execution | [HTTP ingress](/docs/concepts/capabilities) | planned | run serves the accepted commands and views over HTTP on 127.0.0.1 where ingress.network is bound. |
| Execution | [External decisions from a file](/docs/concepts/capabilities) | planned | run --decisions answers external outcomes from a file instead of per line. |
| Execution | [Minted creation identities](/docs/concepts/capabilities) | planned | An identity neither the input nor the payload supplies is minted through a derived identity.mint capability. |
| Execution | [List views with filters](/docs/concepts/specification) | planned | List views over every instance with a state filter and an order. |
| Conformance | [Scenario replay and self-conformance](/docs/concepts/specification) | planned | run --scenario replays an ess-scenario/1 timeline; the suite ESS synthesises from Spindle's own specification runs in task check. |
| Observe | [Telemetry, deploy and the observe UI](/docs/concepts/deployment-targets) | planned | Counters derived from the IR, b10x-spindle metrics, b10x-spindle deploy as a control process with a read-only API, and a browser UI (design: docs/design/observe.md). |
| Deploy | [Bundle, deploy service and registry](/docs/concepts/deployment-targets) | planned | Upload a bundle to deploy it; design milestone M4, no story yet. |
| Deploy | [Cells, ownership and snapshots](/docs/concepts/deployment-targets) | planned | Cells across threads, ownership leases with fencing, snapshots; design milestone M5, no story yet. |

## The tests that hold them

- Derived from the specification: `a_periodic_cause_needs_a_timer_and_a_clock_and_a_cross_component_binding_a_channel` in [`crates/spindle-capability/tests/admission.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/spindle/blob/main/crates/spindle-capability/tests/admission.rs)
- Per component: `each_component_needs_only_what_it_runs` in [`crates/spindle-capability/tests/admission.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/spindle/blob/main/crates/spindle-capability/tests/admission.rs)
- Bind by preference: `admission_takes_the_most_preferred_implementation` in [`crates/spindle-capability/tests/admission.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/spindle/blob/main/crates/spindle-capability/tests/admission.rs)

- Commands against the compiled model: `offer_then_admit_moves_a_deployment_to_admitted` in [`crates/spindle-kernel/tests/deployment.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/spindle/blob/main/crates/spindle-kernel/tests/deployment.rs)
- Memory and SQLite stores: `state_survives_a_restart_on_sqlite` in [`crates/spindle-kernel/tests/deployment.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/spindle/blob/main/crates/spindle-kernel/tests/deployment.rs)
- Periodic bindings: `a_periodic_binding_is_due_every_period` in [`crates/spindle-timer/tests/periodic.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/spindle/blob/main/crates/spindle-timer/tests/periodic.rs)
- Event bindings in process and over TCP: `an_event_reaches_the_bound_component_over_tcp` in [`crates/spindle-channel/tests/channel.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/spindle/blob/main/crates/spindle-channel/tests/channel.rs)
- Every component in one process: `a_match_played_in_one_process_ends_with_a_winner` in [`crates/spindle-host/tests/rally.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/spindle/blob/main/crates/spindle-host/tests/rally.rs)
- The target contract and the process launcher: `the_process_launcher_starts_and_stops_an_instance_and_reports_its_exit` in [`crates/spindle-target/tests/target.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/spindle/blob/main/crates/spindle-target/tests/target.rs)
- QEMU microvm launcher: `a_qemu_microvm_instance_boots_and_runs_b10x_spindle` in [`crates/spindle-qemu/tests/microvm.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/spindle/blob/main/crates/spindle-qemu/tests/microvm.rs)
- Firecracker launcher: `a_firecracker_instance_boots_and_runs_b10x_spindle` in [`crates/spindle-firecracker/tests/firecracker.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/spindle/blob/main/crates/spindle-firecracker/tests/firecracker.rs)
